shape_described: Dataset sample: {shape} (batch excluded). Training treats this as {dims}D spatial data and adds a channel. This dimensionality is described by this model; exact sizes, channels and runtime compatibility remain unverified.
shape_mismatch: Dimension mismatch: dataset sample {shape} is treated as {dims}D spatial data by training (batch excluded; a channel is added), outside this model’s described dimensions. Review the dataset and model; this is advisory, not runtime validation.
shape_unknown: Shape guidance unavailable. Select and inspect a dataset from the current daemon; unsupported or unknown sample layouts require runtime review. Model selection remains available.
shape_ambiguous: Ambiguous dataset sample: {shape} (batch excluded). This may be channel-first 2D data or a shallow 3D volume. Training requires single_channel confirmation for a single-channel volume; do not assume channel compatibility. Runtime compatibility remains unverified.
modelsUnavailable: Model catalogue unavailable. Reconnect to the verified daemon and retry.
connectionChanged: Connection changed. Reload the catalogue before selecting.
untranslated: Daemon-provided description shown in its original language (no matching bundled translation).
